== What changed on the image ==
[[File:ANH-L-mercsunlet-PC-Errata-2013-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[Merc Sunlet]] (Decipher; Decipher's [[Merc Sunlet (Decipher Errata 1998)|November 1998 errata]] was published as text only): The game text changes: “any” becomes “your”; “During” becomes “Once during each of”; “phase,” becomes “phases,”; “'stolen.'” becomes “stolen.”. These are the same words as [[Merc Sunlet (Decipher Errata 1998)|Decipher's errata]]. The slip adds a black strip below the text box with the title “Merc Sunlet” and a white italic “E”.

Lower part of the printed card (the area the slip covers, scaled to the slip's width) and the slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
